title: Ball quotients and complex hyperbolic lattices
summary: Complex hyperbolic n-space and PU(1,n) for every n ≥ 1, lattices of every kind with cusps, finite generation and Selberg's lemma, the analytic quotient, Mok's toroidal and projective minimal compactification, a big Picard extension theorem with Borel algebraicity and uniqueness of the algebraic model, the arithmetic bridge to Shimura data and Baily–Borel, and totally geodesic subvarieties and algebraic subvarieties of the ball times S_Γ, so that Baldi–Ullmo's theorems become library statements.

gaps.title: Normality and smoothness under analytification
gaps.detail: For a variety X over ℂ: X normal iff X^an normal, X smooth if X^an is a complex manifold, and the analytification of the normalization is the analytic normalization, compatibly with structure maps; the converse smooth direction (X smooth ⇒ X^an a manifold) is §C−1.1's smooth-chart comparison, not part of the gap.
gaps.needs: For a variety X over ℂ, normality of X and of X^an are equivalent, a complex-manifold X^an forces X smooth, and the analytification of the normalization of X is the analytic normalization of X^an, compatibly with the structure maps.

gaps.title: Riemann extension on normal complex spaces
gaps.detail: On a normal complex analytic space, a continuous function holomorphic outside a nowhere-dense analytic subset is holomorphic; hence continuous maps between normal spaces holomorphic off such a subset are holomorphic.
gaps.needs: The Riemann extension theorem for continuous functions on normal complex analytic spaces.
